call_points.text: FY27 is a year of operational consolidation with no numeric revenue or margin guidance; management declined to give a percentage outlook.
Management targets positive operating cash flow, gearing below half a turn and industry-typical receivable collection in FY27.
FY26 capex was ₹64 Cr and the programme is substantially complete; FY27 capex will moderate and be funded from internal accruals.
Solar hybrid and grid-tied inverter production capacity has reached around 12,000 to 15,000 units per month.
Retail channel run-rate has grown from about ₹2 Cr per month in FY22 to over ₹25 Cr per month.
Management expects the retail channel to contribute more than 50% of total revenue in FY27.
FY26 margin expansion of 161 bps was driven by product mix toward solar inverters, higher-capacity DC chargers and BESS; management expects to sustain or modestly improve it.
Standalone borrowings rose from ₹75 Cr to ₹196 Cr and trade receivables from ₹155 Cr to ₹243 Cr in FY26.
Working capital cycle has structurally lengthened with government EPC growth; management targets bringing it down to 60-70 days.
A QIP is under consideration but no terms or timeline were given.

operating_notes.text: Consolidated operating cash flow was negative ₹1.94 Cr in FY26 despite EBITDA of ₹67.22 Cr, as trade receivables rose ₹90.67 Cr.
FY26 finance cost rose 66.9% to ₹12.13 Cr and depreciation rose 213.5% to ₹18.4 Cr.
Company operates in a single segment; subsidiaries include Rebreathe Medical Devices, Servotech EV Infra and associate Rhine Solar.
Order from South Central Railway – Vijayawada Division for 1,415 kW rooftop solar EPC, execution within six months of LOA; value not stated.
Secured a 1,415 kW solar rooftop project order from South Central Railway, Vijayawada Division.
FY26 product mix: solar products 51% of revenue, AC and small chargers 27%, DC chargers 15%, INC and AMC 4%, energy storage 1%, power 1%.
Solar hybrid and grid-tied inverter production capacity is around 12,000 to 15,000 units per month.
Retail channel run-rate is over ₹25 Cr per month, up from about ₹2 Cr per month in FY22.
Estimated internal fraud amount stands at ₹2.00-2.50 crore with ₹0.76 crore recovered.
